integrity: Exact universal matrix proof and algebraic block transfer; finite checks on thirteen incidences and exhaustive state orbits for two small examples; computations are corroboration rather than infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Realized finite partial geometries only; two-layer linear waves in characteristic two; individual orbit multiplicities require incidence-specific binary kernel ranks; no independent audit or exhaustive historical priority guarantee.
title: Four exact reversible-wave clocks on incidence graphs of finite partial geometries
